name: Paperless-ngx
description: Paperless-ngx scans, indexes, and archives your paper documents with OCR, full-text search, and automatic tagging. It turns a pile of PDFs and scans into a searchable personal archive that you own. The successor to the popular Paperless project, actively maintained.
highlights: Web UI plus a robust REST API
curatorNote: Paperless-ngx solves the most boring problem in the world, completely. A personal archive you can actually search changes how you keep records.
